This is exactly right. I hit "Mark as read" on the Copilot card in the Read later view, it dropped out of that list, and when the last one cleared I got a friendly "all caught up" message — which is just the feeling I wanted, the list emptying as I get through things. And when I went back to All bookmarks, the card was still sitting there, so marking it read cleared it from the to-read pile without deleting it from my library. That's precisely the behavior I was after, and having the "mark as read" button right on the card in that view is natural.

That handles the reading-and-clearing half nicely. The one piece from last time still open is being able to take something I already saved normally and set it aside into Read later after the fact — I don't think we've seen that yet. Could we cover that next?
